content.title: Utility auto-pay step-by-step
content.summary: To set up online auto-pay for your City of Arvada utility billing account, visit the Pay My Bill page and either log in or register for a new account. After adding your account details and selecting your notification preferences, choose the AutoPay option, add a payment method, and confirm your payment frequency to complete the enrollment process.
content.body:
Please follow these instructions to set up your City of Arvada utility billing account with online auto-pay.

## Step 1

Visit the [Pay My Bill page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/453/Pay-My-Bill) and click the "Pay Online" link. You may want to bookmark this page for future use.

![screenshot of Pay My Bill page with \"Pay Online\" button](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7523)

## Step 2

Log in or click "Register Now" if you do not have an existing online account.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7536)

## Step 3

Click "Accounts". Click "Add Account" when setting up an account for the first time.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7529)![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7530)

## Step 4

Fill in your account and customer number that can be found at the top of your utility bill. Select email and / or text notification preferences.

![screenshot of account information including account and customer number and notification preferences](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7528)

## Step 5

Once the account is added, select the "AutoPay" button.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7527)

## Step 6

Click "Add a Payment Method" if the preferred payment method is not listed.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7533)

## Step 7

Select Credit, Debit, or E-Check tab and fill in your payment information.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7532)

## Step 8

The frequency for payment is required to be set to the bill due date. Select "Create AutoPay" to confirm enrollment.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7531)

After your selection is complete, the AutoPay toggle will be shown as activated with your listed payment method.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7534)
